brand.name: Creative Nepal
brand.webDescription: Point of sale, IRD-ready invoicing and stock control for marts, pharmacies and restaurants.

error.serverBodyWeb: This page hit an unexpected error. Try again — if it keeps happening, send the reference below to support.
error.serverBodyAdmin: The dashboard hit an unexpected error. Try again — if it keeps happening, send the reference below to engineering.
error.appCrashedBody: Something broke outside the page itself. Reloading usually clears it.
error.notFoundBodyWeb: This page does not exist, or it moved. Check the address, or start again from the home page.
error.notFoundBodyAdmin: This page does not exist, or it moved. Start again from the overview.
error.notFoundBodyMarketing: This page does not exist, or it has not been published yet.
error.recordNotFoundBody: This business, plan or user does not exist any more. It may have been deleted.
error.workspaceNotFoundBody: That record does not exist, or it belongs to a different business. Switch business, or pick a screen from the sidebar.
error.screenFailedBody: The rest of your workspace is fine. Retry the screen, or pick another one from the sidebar.
error.viewFailedBody: The rest of the dashboard is fine. Retry the view, or pick another one from the sidebar.
error.dataFailedBody: The request failed. Retry it, or move to another screen and come back.
error.authUnavailableBody: We could not reach the authentication service. Try again in a moment.

auth.signInSubtitleAdmin: Sign in to the admin dashboard.
auth.forgotPasswordSent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way.
auth.resetLinkInvalid: This reset link is missing or invalid.

overview.title: Overview
overview.emptyBody: Businesses appear here as accounts create them.
overview.bySectorHint: Each sector is an independent subscription surface.

businesses.title: Businesses
businesses.description: Every business across every account. Suspend or close a business independently of its own owner.
businesses.cbmsQueued: Invoices are being queued for CBMS
businesses.auditEmptyBody: Audit entries appear here as this business issues, prints, and credits invoices.
businesses.noSubscription: No active subscription. This business has no plan entitlements.
businesses.subscriptionEnding: Subscription will end at the current period end

plans.title: Plans
plans.description: The global plan catalog. Feature flags here drive entitlements and seat limits.
plans.keyHint: Lowercase slug, unique within the sector.
plans.priceHint: In major units; stored as integer minor units.
plans.maxStaffHint: Enforced by Better Auth's own membership limit.

billing.title: Platform billing
billing.description: What businesses owe this platform — distinct from the invoices they issue their own customers.
billing.emptyBody: Invoices appear once the billing run charges an active subscription.

users.title: Users
users.description: Manage user accounts, roles, sessions and access.
users.noAccessBody: This session cannot list users. Stop impersonating, or sign in with a platform admin account.
users.detailsHint: Read straight from the server, so it reflects changes made elsewhere.
users.sessionsEmptyBody: This user is not signed in anywhere.

content.title: Content
content.description: Every public page on the marketing site. Published changes reach visitors within a minute.
content.deleteBody: /{slug} disappears from the public site immediately, along with every translation.
content.slugChangeHint: Changing this changes the public URL; old links stop working.
content.newPageHint: The page starts as a draft with no blocks. Add content, then publish it to put it on the public site.
content.pageDetailsHint: Title and search-engine metadata for this locale.
content.seoTitleHint: Falls back to the page title.
content.noIndexHint: Sends noindex — use for legal or thank-you pages.
content.blocksHint: Rendered top to bottom on the public page.
content.blocksEmptyBody: Add a hero to open the page, then stack features, FAQs or a closing call to action.
content.heading: Heading
content.question: Question
content.imageUrlHint: Optional. A site path or a full https URL.
content.markdownHint: Headings, lists, links and emphasis. Raw HTML is not rendered.

blockHint.hero: Headline with up to two buttons

content.navigationDescription: Header links and footer groups for the public site, per language.
content.headerLinksHint: Shown in the public site header, in this order.
content.footerGroupsHint: Each group becomes a column in the site footer.

site.previewBanner: Draft preview — this page is not live.

workspace.noBusinessBody: Create a business to start selling. Your account can hold several — a mart, a pharmacy and a restaurant each bill independently.

pos.title: Point of sale
pos.searchPlaceholder: Search by name or SKU, or scan a barcode...
pos.cartEmpty: Add items to start a sale.
pos.panRequired: Buyer name and PAN are required above NPR 10,000.

products.title: Products
products.emptyBody: Products added here become sellable at the point of sale.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.description: Every number ever issued, including voided and credited ones — invoices are never deleted.
invoices.fiscalYearPlaceholder: Fiscal year, e.g. 2083-84 (required for the register export)

batches.title: Batches
batches.description: Stock nearing expiry. An expired batch is automatically unsellable — it cannot be dispensed even if selected.

purchasing.title: Purchasing
purchasing.description: Suppliers, orders, goods receipt and bills. Stock enters the system here.
purchasing.ordersEmptyBody: Create an order against a supplier, then record the goods when they arrive.
purchasing.billsEmptyBody: A supplier's bill can arrive before, with, or after the goods.
purchasing.receiveHint: Stock enters here, and cost is recomputed as a weighted average against what is already on hand.

restaurant.kitchenDescription: Tickets are grouped by station. Refreshes every few seconds.
restaurant.kitchenEmptyBody: Confirmed orders appear here as tickets.
restaurant.menuDescription: Turning an item off hides it from the QR menu immediately and blocks it at checkout.
restaurant.tablesDescription: Billing covers the whole sitting — every order placed against the table.
restaurant.tableFreed: Table freed for the next sitting

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Business details, plan, and what this account owes for the platform.
settings.businessDetailsHint: The legal name and PAN printed on every invoice.
settings.ownerOnly: Only an owner can change business details
settings.noPlan: No active plan. Ask the operator to assign one.

staff.title: Staff
staff.description: Roles are enforced by the API on every action, not just hidden in this interface.
